source_title: VIZ Media Titles Now Available on MangaPlaza
source_excerpt:
Up to 10% Point Reward Promotion on all VIZ Media Titles
LOS ANGELES , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- VIZ Media and NTT Solmare Corp. have announced that VIZ Media's manga titles are now available on MangaPlaza , one of the U.S.'s largest digital manga content libraries. To celebrate this momentous occasion, MangaPlaza is launching a point reward promotion for all VIZ Media's titles.
For a limited time, users can earn 10% in point rewards when unlocking content for VIZ Media titles, up to 3,000 points. The campaign will run from October 29, 2026 at 7:00 PM through November 12, 2026 at 6:59 AM Pacific Time. Visit the special promotion page on MangaPlaza's website to participate.
Below are just a few VIZ Media titles that are now available on MangaPlaza, with more to be added in the future.

Author: Tatsuya Endo Synopsis: Not one to depend on others, Twilight has his work cut out for him, procuring both a wife and a child for his mission to infiltrate an elite private school. What he doesn't know is that the wife he's chosen is an assassin and the child he's adopted is a telepath!
Author: Gege Akutami Synopsis: Although Yuji Itadori looks like your average teenager, his immense physical strength is something to behold! Every sports club wants him to join, but Itadori would rather hang out with the school outcasts in the Occult Research Club. One day, the club manages to get their hands on a sealed cursed object. Little do they know the terror they'll unleash when they break the sealâ¦
Author: Koyoharu Gotouge Synopsis: Learning to destroy demons won't be easy, and Tanjiro barely knows where to start. The surprise appearance of another boy named Giyu, who seems to know what's going on, might provide some answersâbut only if Tanjiro can stop Giyu from killing his sister first!
Author: Oreco Tachibana Synopsis: On the surface, Satoko has it allâshe's beautiful, the daughter of a nobleman, and at a prime age for marriage. Unfortunately, she is also quite ill and only has a short time left to live. Before she can secure a marriage that will redeem her worth in her family's eyes, she finds herself the target of the mysterious assassin Shinpei, and her plans are put in jeopardy. In order to save herself, she makes a desperate proposalâof marriage! When it comes to love, however, Shinpei takes "until death do we part" seriously.
